definitions.gloss: heart sound; sound produced by the heartbeat
definitions.explanation: The sounds produced by the beating heart, heard through a stethoscope during a medical examination. Used in medical and clinical contexts.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}が{心音|しんおん}を{聴診|ちょうしん}した。
examples.english: The doctor listened to the heart sounds.

examples.japanese: {心音|しんおん}に{異常|いじょう}は{見|み}られなかった。
examples.english: No abnormality was found in the heart sounds.

examples.japanese: {聴診器|ちょうしんき}を{胸|むね}に{当|あ}てて{心音|しんおん}を{確認|かくにん}すると、{雑音|ざつおん}が{聞|き}こえた。
examples.english: When I placed the stethoscope on the chest to check the heart sounds, I heard a murmur.

notes:
{心|しん} means heart; {音|おん} means sound. A technical medical term used in clinical settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心音|しんおん}を{聴|き}く／{聴診|ちょうしん}する: to listen to heart sounds
- {心音|しんおん}に{異常|いじょう}がある: to have abnormal heart sounds
- {心音|しんおん}{確認|かくにん}: checking heart sounds
- {胎児|たいじ}の{心音|しんおん}: fetal heartbeat
